title: CyBiasBench: Benchmarking Bias in LLM Agents for Cyber-Attack Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2605.07830v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in offensive cybersecurity. In this paper, we reveal an interesting phenomenon: different agents exhibit distinct attack patterns. Specifically, agents exhibit distinct attack-selection biases, differing in both the families they explore and the concentration of their efforts. These patterns remain relatively stable across prompt variations. To systematically quantify this behavior, we introduce CyBiasBench, a comprehensive 630-session benchmark that evaluates five agents on three targets and four prompt conditions with ten attack families. We identify explicit bias across agents, with different dominant attack families and varying entropy levels in their attack-family allocation distributions. translated_title: CyBiasBench：面向网络攻击场景的大语言模型智能体偏见基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为进攻性网络安全中的自主智能体。在本文中，我们揭示了一个有趣的现象：不同的智能体表现出截然不同的攻击模式。具体而言，智能体展现出明显的攻击选择偏见，在所探索的攻击家族以及攻击努力的集中程度上均存在差异。这些模式在不同的提示变化下保持相对稳定。为了系统地量化这种行为，我们提出了CyBiasBench，一个包含630个会话的综合基准，在三个目标、四种提示条件和十个攻击家族上评估五个智能体。我们识别出各智能体之间存在明显的偏见，表现为不同的主导攻击家族以及攻击家族分配分布中不同的熵水平。这种偏见刻画了智能体在所评估环境中的行为特征，并提供了超越总体攻击成功率之外的信息。此外，我们的实验……
tldr: 该论文提出CyBiasBench基准测试，揭示不同LLM智能体在网络攻击场景中表现出稳定且明显的攻击选择偏见，这种偏见刻画了智能体行为特征，并提供超越总体攻击成功率之外的信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CyBiasBench, a benchmark revealing that LLM agents exhibit distinct and stable attack-selection biases in cyber-attack scenarios, characterizing agent behavior beyond aggregate attack success rates.
